Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JACOB, a frail but determined man. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Privilege To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live. Please Welcome The One And Only JACOB.

The room erupts in applause as Jacob takes the stage. He is handed the plaque, and with a hint of a smile, he accepts it.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob lies in bed, the plaque from earlier sitting on his nightstand. He gazes at it, a mix of emotions on his face. Suddenly, his eyes wander to a dusty old book on his shelf. He gets out of bed and walks over to it.

JACOB
(whispering to himself)
Quantum Immortality...

He opens the book, and a yellowed piece of paper slips out. Jacob's eyes scan the page, and his expression changes from nostalgia to confusion.

JACOB
(reading)
"If The Multiverse Is Infinite, And Every Possible Branch Exists, Then It Is Possible For A Human To Live Forever..."

Jacob's eyes widen as he reads on. His mind begins to reel with the implications.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S MIND - NIGHT

Jacob's thoughts spiral out of control. He sees multiple versions of himself, each living a different life. He sees himself as a young man, full of life and vigor. He sees himself as an old man, frail and weak. He sees himself as a child, playing with his siblings.

JACOB
(whispering)
I Am The Multiverse. I Am The Universe.

The room around him begins to distort and blur. Jacob's voice rises to a fever pitch.

JACOB
I AM THE ONLY ONE WHO KNOWS THE TRUTH! I AM THE ONLY ONE WHO CAN SEE THE MULTIVERSE!

The camera zooms in on Jacob's face, his eyes bulging with madness.

CUT TO:

INT. JACOB'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jacob's body begins to shake. He falls to the floor, his mind shattered by the weight of his own theory.

JACOB
(whispering)
I Am The Universe... I Am The Multiverse...

The camera lingers on Jacob's face, his eyes frozen in a mixture of terror and despair.

FADE TO BLACK.
